s0301.literal: The contract deed fee was increased to three cash.
s0301.idiomatic: The contract deed fee was increased to three cash.

s0302.literal: A planning-office exchange treasury was established at Shangdu; the worn-note replacement fee was increased from two fen to three fen per ingot.
s0302.idiomatic: A planning-office exchange treasury was established at Shangdu, and the worn-note replacement fee was increased from two fen to three fen per ingot.

s0303.literal: Summer, fourth month, guimao day: the Mobile Privy Council Chief Pacification Office was established, and six Uighur relay stations were set up.
s0303.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month, guimao day: the Mobile Privy Council Chief Pacification Office was established, and six Uighur relay stations were set up.

s0304.literal: On bingwu day, ships for the Japan expedition were used to transport grain between Jianghuai and to train troops in naval warfare.
s0304.idiomatic: On bingwu day ships for the Japan expedition were used to transport grain between Jianghuai and to train troops in naval warfare.

s0305.literal: On gengxu day, surveillance censor Chen Tianxiang impeached right vice chancellor Lu Shirong for crimes; an edict ordered both Shirong and Tianxiang to proceed to Shangdu.
s0305.idiomatic: On gengxu day surveillance censor Chen Tianxiang impeached right vice chancellor Lu Shirong for crimes; an edict ordered both Shirong and Tianxiang to proceed to Shangdu.

s0306.literal: On renzi day, Zhang Er of Jiangling's wife Dame Deng gave birth to three sons at one delivery.
s0306.idiomatic: On renzi day Zhang Er of Jiangling's wife Dame Deng gave birth to three sons at one delivery.

s0307.literal: On guichou day, an edict ordered pursuit of the Song Prince of Guang and Chen Yizhong.
s0307.idiomatic: On guichou day an edict ordered pursuit of the Song Prince of Guang and Chen Yizhong.

s0308.literal: One official each from the Central Secretariat, Privy Council, and Censorate was dispatched to adjudicate criminal prisoners in Dadu and the various routes.
s0308.idiomatic: One official each from the Central Secretariat, Privy Council, and Censorate was dispatched to adjudicate criminal prisoners in Dadu and the various routes.

s0309.literal: Locusts in Dadu, Bianliang, Yidu, Luzhou, Hejian, Jining, Guide, and Baoding.
s0309.idiomatic: Locusts struck Dadu, Bianliang, Yidu, Luzhou, Hejian, Jining, Guide, and Baoding.

s0310.literal: On xinyou day, one hundred Japan-expedition ships built in Tamna were granted to Goryeo.
s0310.idiomatic: On xinyou day 100 Japan-expedition ships built in Tamna were granted to Goryeo.

s0311.literal: On renxu day, censor-in-chief Alat'temur and Guo You, attendant censor Bai Tultemur, associate administrator Sadishimi, and others memorialized the confessed crimes of Lu Shirong.
s0311.idiomatic: On renxu day censor-in-chief Alat'temur and Guo You, attendant censor Bai Tultemur, associate administrator Sadishimi, and others memorialized the confessed crimes of Lu Shirong.

s0312.literal: Alat'temur and the others confronted Shirong before the Emperor; Shirong fully confessed.
s0312.idiomatic: Alat'temur and the others confronted Shirong before the Emperor, and Shirong fully confessed.

s0313.literal: The Six Ministries were restored to third rank as before.
s0313.idiomatic: The Six Ministries were restored to third rank as before.

s0314.literal: An edict said: "Let An Tong and the elder ministers deliberate on what Shirong had implemented — what should be abolished, abolish it; what should be changed, change it; as for those he employed who are truly innocent, I shall decide myself.
s0314.idiomatic: An edict said, "Let An Tong and the elder ministers deliberate on what Shirong had implemented — what should be abolished, abolish it; what should be changed, change it; as for those he employed who are truly innocent, I shall decide myself.

s0315.literal: " On guihai day, an order directed that Maishuding's upright conduct be combined with An Tong's administration of secretariat affairs.
s0315.idiomatic: " On guihai day an order directed that Maishuding's upright conduct be combined with An Tong's administration of secretariat affairs.

s0316.literal: Fifth month, jiaxu day: censor-in-chief Guo You was made associate administrator of the Central Secretariat.
s0316.idiomatic: Fifth month, jiaxu day: censor-in-chief Guo You was made associate administrator of the Central Secretariat.

s0317.literal: On dingchou day, commercial taxes at Shangdu were reduced.
s0317.idiomatic: On dingchou day commercial taxes at Shangdu were reduced.

s0318.literal: On wuyin day, drought in Guangping, Bianliang, Jun, and Zheng.
s0318.idiomatic: On wuyin day drought struck Guangping, Bianliang, Jun, and Zheng.

s0319.literal: Because almanacs for distant regions were supplied from the capital and did not arrive on time, those used by the four branch secretariats in Jinghu and elsewhere were printed at Longxing; those used in Hala Zhang, Hexi, Western Sichuan, and elsewhere were printed at Jingzhao.
s0319.idiomatic: Because almanacs for distant regions were supplied from the capital and did not arrive on time, those used by the four branch secretariats in Jinghu and elsewhere were printed at Longxing, and those used in Hala Zhang, Hexi, Western Sichuan, and elsewhere were printed at Jingzhao.

s0320.literal: An edict fixed grain tax at three shi per qing of land in Ganzhou.
s0320.idiomatic: An edict fixed grain tax at three shi per qing of land in Ganzhou.

s0321.literal: On renwu day, one thousand troops were assigned to repair the Ashi salt-field warehouse.
s0321.idiomatic: On renwu day 1,000 troops were assigned to repair the Ashi salt-field warehouse.

s0322.literal: Xindu was made campaign commissioner of Kiril, granted a tiger tally; an order said: "Do not launch distant campaigns; pacify only those nearby who do not submit.
s0322.idiomatic: Xindu was made campaign commissioner of Kiril and granted a tiger tally; an order said, "Do not launch distant campaigns; pacify only those nearby who do not submit.

s0323.literal: " The Right Ba and other cave tribes were pacified.
s0323.idiomatic: " The Right Ba and other cave tribes were pacified.

s0324.literal: On jiashen day, the Bianliang Pacification Commission was established; following the precedent of the Prince of Anxi, from south of Bianliang to the Yangtze a princely kin was stationed to govern it.
s0324.idiomatic: On jiashen day the Bianliang Pacification Commission was established; following the precedent of the Prince of Anxi, from south of Bianliang to the Yangtze a princely kin was stationed to govern it.

s0325.literal: On dinghai day, Central Secretariat officials said: "Six Ministry posts are excessively numerous; the quota should be fixed at sixty-eight, and the rest all cut.
s0325.idiomatic: On dinghai day Central Secretariat officials said, "Six Ministry posts are excessively numerous; the quota should be fixed at 68, and the rest all cut.

s0326.literal: " An edict ordered that those who were incorrupt and capable be retained.
s0326.idiomatic: " An edict ordered that those who were incorrupt and capable be retained.

s0327.literal: Bows, arrows, and weapons seized in Han territories and Jiangnan were divided into three grades: lower grade destroyed; middle grade granted to nearby Mongols; upper grade stored in armories;
s0327.idiomatic: Bows, arrows, and weapons seized in Han territories and Jiangnan were divided into three grades: lower grade destroyed, middle grade granted to nearby Mongols, and upper grade stored in armories;

s0328.literal: those routes with branch secretariats, branch armies, or branch censorates were to manage them; where there were none, darughachi, Uighurs, or Muslims holding office were to manage them; Han Chinese and newly submitted officials, even if in office, were not to participate.
s0328.idiomatic: Routes with branch secretariats, branch armies, or branch censorates were to manage them; where there were none, darughachi, Uighurs, or Muslims holding office were to manage them; Han Chinese and newly submitted officials, even if in office, were not to participate.

s0329.literal: On wuzi day, the prefectures of Jiang, Wuding, Duolimiegai, and others were upgraded to circuits.
s0329.idiomatic: On wuzi day the prefectures of Jiang, Wuding, Duolimiegai, and others were upgraded to circuits.

s0330.literal: Yunnan branch secretariat official Totemur spoke on more than ten matters — remitting arrears, collecting concealed property, garrisoning rebellious peoples, clarifying promotions and demotions, abolishing transport offices, provisioning princes, taxing wealthy households, removing heavy levies, judging bandits, increasing relay horses, taking hostages, fixing salaries, promoting agriculture and sericulture, favoring scholars, caring for those who died in service, and capturing fugitives; the Central Secretariat was ordered to consider and implement what was feasible.
s0330.idiomatic: Yunnan branch secretariat official Totemur spoke on more than ten matters — remitting arrears, collecting concealed property, garrisoning rebellious peoples, clarifying promotions and demotions, abolishing transport offices, provisioning princes, taxing wealthy households, removing heavy levies, judging bandits, increasing relay horses, taking hostages, fixing salaries, promoting agriculture and sericulture, favoring scholars, caring for those who died in service, and capturing fugitives; the Central Secretariat was ordered to consider and implement what was feasible.

s0331.literal: On gengyin day, silkworm disaster in Zhending, Guangping, Hejian, Enzhou, Daming, and Jinan.
s0331.idiomatic: On gengyin day silkworm disaster struck Zhending, Guangping, Hejian, Enzhou, Daming, and Jinan.

s0332.literal: One additional captain and deputy captain was added at each gate of Dadu.
s0332.idiomatic: One additional captain and deputy captain was added at each gate of Dadu.

s0333.literal: An order directed Doreji to gather displaced famine refugees in Gan, Sha, Su, and other prefectures.
s0333.idiomatic: An order directed Doreji to gather displaced famine refugees in Gan, Sha, Su, and other prefectures.

s0334.literal: The Mobile Censorate was moved back to Hangzhou.
s0334.idiomatic: The Mobile Censorate was moved back to Hangzhou.

s0335.literal: On dingyou day, the Mobile Privy Council was moved to Jiankang.
s0335.idiomatic: On dingyou day the Mobile Privy Council was moved to Jiankang.

s0336.literal: On wuxu day, drought in Bianliang, Huaimeng, Puzhou, Dongchang, Guangping, Pingyang, Zhangde, and Weihui.
s0336.idiomatic: On wuxu day drought struck Bianliang, Huaimeng, Puzhou, Dongchang, Guangping, Pingyang, Zhangde, and Weihui.

s0337.literal: The Jiangnan shipbuilding intendant office was abolished.
s0337.idiomatic: The Jiangnan shipbuilding intendant office was abolished.

s0338.literal: Chen Rihuan fled to a sea harbor; the Prince of Zhennan ordered Li Heng to pursue and attack, defeating him.
s0338.idiomatic: Chen Rihuan fled to a sea harbor; the Prince of Zhennan ordered Li Heng to pursue and attack, defeating him.

s0339.literal: As summer rains brought epidemic, the troops wished to return north to Siming Prefecture; Suodu and others were ordered back to Wuli.
s0339.idiomatic: As summer rains brought epidemic, the troops wished to return north to Siming Prefecture; Suodu and others were ordered back to Wuli.

s0340.literal: Annam pursued with troops, and Suodu died in battle;
s0340.idiomatic: Annam pursued with troops, and Suodu died in battle;

s0341.literal: Heng brought up the rear to protect the Prince of Zhennan; struck by a poisoned arrow in the left knee, he reached Siming, where the poison took effect and he died.
s0341.idiomatic: Heng brought up the rear to protect the Prince of Zhennan; struck by a poisoned arrow in the left knee, he reached Siming, where the poison took effect and he died.

s0342.literal: Sixth month, gengxu day: the Jurchen and Suiyede were ordered to build two hundred ships and Japan-expedition wind-facing vessels.
s0342.idiomatic: Sixth month, gengxu day: the Jurchen and Suiyede were ordered to build 200 ships and Japan-expedition wind-facing vessels.

s0343.literal: On xinhai day, Yangzhou presented auspicious lingzhi fungus.
s0343.idiomatic: On xinhai day Yangzhou presented auspicious lingzhi fungus.

s0344.literal: On bingchen day, Masuhu and Ali were dispatched with one thousand ingots of notes to Mabatu to seek rare treasures; Masuhu was granted a tiger tally and Ali a gold tally.
s0344.idiomatic: On bingchen day Masuhu and Ali were dispatched with 1,000 ingots of notes to Mabatu to seek rare treasures; Masuhu was granted a tiger tally and Ali a gold tally.

s0345.literal: Goryeo sent envoys to present tribute.
s0345.idiomatic: Goryeo sent envoys to present tribute.

s0346.literal: On gengwu day, an edict reduced commercial taxes, abolished broker houses, and merged the maritime trade office into the transport commission.
s0346.idiomatic: On gengwu day an edict reduced commercial taxes, abolished broker houses, and merged the maritime trade office into the transport commission.

s0347.literal: Left vice chancellor Lü Shiqing requested five months' leave to visit his mother in Jiangzhou; the Emperor granted it, and said to An Tong: "You Mongols would not know of such matters; I have no Han Chinese close at hand either — approval or refusal is all my own decision.
s0347.idiomatic: Left vice chancellor Lü Shiqing requested five months' leave to visit his mother in Jiangzhou; the Emperor granted it and said to An Tong, "You Mongols would not know of such matters; I have no Han Chinese close at hand either — approval or refusal is all my own decision.

s0348.literal: You must devote yourselves wholeheartedly to governing the people well, and not let them be heavily burdened into rebellion, to my shame.
s0348.idiomatic: You must devote yourselves wholeheartedly to governing the people well and not let them be heavily burdened into rebellion, to my shame.

s0349.literal: " Associate administrator Zhang Derun presented his four hundred household dependents to the crown prince.
s0349.idiomatic: " Associate administrator Zhang Derun presented his 400 household dependents to the crown prince.

s0350.literal: Field mice in the Mahu department ate the crops nearly to extinction; its commissioner prayed at a shrine, and all the mice went into the water and died.
s0350.idiomatic: Field mice in the Mahu department ate the crops nearly to extinction; its commissioner prayed at a shrine, and all the mice went into the water and died.

s0351.literal: Autumn, seventh month, renshen day: warm-stone bathhouses and changing halls were constructed.
s0351.idiomatic: Autumn, seventh month, renshen day: warm-stone bathhouses and changing halls were constructed.

s0352.literal: On guiyou day, an edict forbade hunting.
s0352.idiomatic: On guiyou day an edict forbade hunting.

s0353.literal: On jiaxu day, an order directed the Secretariat Directorate to compile the Geographic Treatise.
s0353.idiomatic: On jiaxu day an order directed the Secretariat Directorate to compile the Geographic Treatise.

s0354.literal: On yihai day, the surrendered Annam officials Prince Zhao and the four marquises Wudao, Wanyi, Zhangxian, and Zhanghuai came to court.
s0354.idiomatic: On yihai day the surrendered Annam officials Prince Zhao and the four marquises Wudao, Wanyi, Zhangxian, and Zhanghuai came to court.

s0355.literal: On wuyin day, locusts in the capital.
s0355.idiomatic: On wuyin day locusts struck the capital.

s0356.literal: Three hundred newly submitted garrison-farming troops of Ganzhou were divided off to farm in Yijinai.
s0356.idiomatic: 300 newly submitted garrison-farming troops of Ganzhou were divided off to farm in Yijinai.

s0357.literal: On jimao day, one thousand shi of rice was issued from the granary to the poor of Onggirat.
s0357.idiomatic: On jimao day 1,000 shi of rice was issued from the granary to the poor of Onggirat.

s0358.literal: On renwu day, left vice chancellor Wang Weizheng of the Shaanxi-Sichuan Branch Secretariat had an audience.
s0358.idiomatic: On renwu day left vice chancellor Wang Weizheng of the Shaanxi-Sichuan Branch Secretariat had an audience.

s0359.literal: On jiashen day, the great and small ten cave tribes pacified by Kölügis and others were reorganized into prefectures, subprefectures, and counties.
s0359.idiomatic: On jiashen day the great and small ten cave tribes pacified by Kölügis and others were reorganized into prefectures, subprefectures, and counties.

s0360.literal: The walls of Bianliang were repaired.
s0360.idiomatic: The walls of Bianliang were repaired.

s0361.literal: On dinghai day, Guangdong pacification commissioner Yuedimishi had an audience; with the surrendered chieftains Guo Fenggui and others he arrived at the capital and reported that more than one hundred fifty mountain stockades had submitted.
s0361.idiomatic: On dinghai day Guangdong pacification commissioner Yuedimishi had an audience; with the surrendered chieftains Guo Fenggui and others he arrived at the capital and reported that more than 150 mountain stockades had submitted.

s0362.literal: The Emperor asked: "Did they submit only after fighting, or did they submit as soon as summoned?
s0362.idiomatic: The Emperor asked, "Did they submit only after fighting, or did they submit as soon as summoned?

s0363.literal: " Yuedimishi replied: "Those chiefs who resisted I have already quartered; the rest all submitted when summoned.
s0363.idiomatic: " Yuedimishi replied, "Those chiefs who resisted I have already quartered; the rest all submitted when summoned.

s0364.literal: " He added: "After Tashu's troops passed, the people were never settled; prefecture and county officials again failed to arrive, so bandits each held territory and killed one another, and the population steadily declined; now good officials should be selected to go govern there.
s0364.idiomatic: " He added, "After Tashu's troops passed, the people were never settled; prefecture and county officials again failed to arrive, so bandits each held territory and killed one another, and the population steadily declined; now good officials should be selected to go govern there.

s0366.literal: On gengyin day, the Privy Council said: "The troops campaigning against Jiaozhi under Prince of Zhennan Tuohan have fought long and are exhausted; request one thousand Mongol troops from thirty thousand orlu households of Orluchi and others, and four thousand Han and newly submitted troops from the Jianghuai, Jiangxi, and Jinghu mobile armies; select good generals to lead them under Prince Tuohan and Ala Haiya to campaign against Jiaozhi.
s0366.idiomatic: On gengyin day the Privy Council said, "The troops campaigning against Jiaozhi under Prince of Zhennan Tuohan have fought long and are exhausted; request 1,000 Mongol troops from 30,000 orlu households of Orluchi and others, and 4,000 Han and newly submitted troops from the Jianghuai, Jiangxi, and Jinghu mobile armies; select good generals to lead them under Prince Tuohan and Ala Haiya to campaign against Jiaozhi.

s0368.literal: Tangudai was again made left vice chancellor of the Jinghu Branch Secretariat.
s0368.idiomatic: Tangudai was again made left vice chancellor of the Jinghu Branch Secretariat.

s0369.literal: Tangudai requested that the Jiaozhi expedition troops be released home to rest; an edict ordered this handled by Tuohan and Ala Haiya.
s0369.idiomatic: Tangudai requested that the Jiaozhi expedition troops be released home to rest; an edict ordered this handled by Tuohan and Ala Haiya.

s0370.literal: Farming tools, oxen, and seed were granted to the poor of Prince Ajigi's appanage to sow and cultivate on their own.
s0370.idiomatic: Farming tools, oxen, and seed were granted to the poor of Prince Ajigi's appanage to sow and cultivate on their own.

s0371.literal: On yiwei day, the Yunnan branch secretariat said: "This year we cannot yet campaign against Burma; after the autumn harvest, please first attack the Luobeidian and other tribes.
s0371.idiomatic: On yiwei day the Yunnan branch secretariat said, "This year we cannot yet campaign against Burma; after the autumn harvest, please first attack the Luobeidian and other tribes.

s0373.literal: On gengzi day, the three prefectures of Kai, Da, and Liangshan were made subordinate to Kuizhou Circuit.
s0373.idiomatic: On gengzi day the three prefectures of Kai, Da, and Liangshan were made subordinate to Kuizhou Circuit.

s0374.literal: Twelve thousand four hundred ingots of notes were granted as capital; interest was to sustain the impoverished garrison-farming troops of Gan and Su prefectures.
s0374.idiomatic: 12,400 ingots of notes were granted as capital; interest was to sustain the impoverished garrison-farming troops of Gan and Su prefectures.

s0375.literal: Eighth month, xinyou day: officials were ordered to sacrifice to the Dipper for three days.
s0375.idiomatic: Eighth month, xinyou day: officials were ordered to sacrifice to the Dipper for three days.

s0376.literal: On wushen day, ten thousand Sichuan garrison troops were divided off to garrison-farm at Chengdu.
s0376.idiomatic: On wushen day 10,000 Sichuan garrison troops were divided off to garrison-farm at Chengdu.

s0377.literal: On bingchen day, the imperial carriage arrived from Shangdu.
s0377.idiomatic: On bingchen day the imperial carriage arrived from Shangdu.

s0378.literal: On jiwei day, an edict restored the Currency Commission, rank 2b, with Dashman in charge.
s0378.idiomatic: On jiwei day an edict restored the Currency Commission, rank 2b, with Dashman in charge.

s0379.literal: Initially, Helü Huosun had argued that the Currency Commission's merchants were supplied food and drink and given military escorts wherever they went, which truly burdened and inconvenienced the people; he memorialized to abolish it.
s0379.idiomatic: Initially Helü Huosun had argued that the Currency Commission's merchants were supplied food and drink and given military escorts wherever they went, which truly burdened and inconvenienced the people; he memorialized to abolish it.

s0380.literal: At this time Dashman again memorialized to restore it.
s0380.idiomatic: At this time Dashman again memorialized to restore it.

s0381.literal: On bingyin day, three thousand Mongol troops were dispatched to garrison-farm at Qing, Cang, and Jinghai.
s0381.idiomatic: On bingyin day 3,000 Mongol troops were dispatched to garrison-farm at Qing, Cang, and Jinghai.

s0382.literal: On wuchen day, the ban on maritime merchants was lifted.
s0382.idiomatic: On wuchen day the ban on maritime merchants was lifted.

s0383.literal: The Hala Zhang and Jinchi pacification commissions were merged into one, based at Yongchang.
s0383.idiomatic: The Hala Zhang and Jinchi pacification commissions were merged into one, based at Yongchang.

s0384.literal: The Lin'an Guangxi Circuit Pacification Commission was established.
s0384.idiomatic: The Lin'an Guangxi Circuit Pacification Commission was established.

s0385.literal: Central Secretariat officials memorialized: "We were recently ordered to register Jianghuai boatmen; all Jianghuai people can swim, and we fear many will be disturbed by this.
s0385.idiomatic: Central Secretariat officials memorialized, "We were recently ordered to register Jianghuai boatmen; all Jianghuai people can swim, and we fear many will be disturbed by this.

s0388.literal: Initially private brewing was permitted; one shi of rice yielded one ingot in tax.
s0388.idiomatic: Initially private brewing was permitted; one shi of rice yielded one ingot in tax.

s0389.literal: Lu Shirong established a monopoly with fifty thousand ingots of official notes as capital; one shi of rice yielded ten ingots in tax, ten times the former rate.
s0389.idiomatic: Lu Shirong established a monopoly with 50,000 ingots of official notes as capital; one shi of rice yielded 10 ingots in tax, ten times the former rate.

s0390.literal: At this time the monopoly was abolished, private brewing permitted again, and the tax increased from one to five ingots per shi.
s0390.idiomatic: At this time the monopoly was abolished, private brewing was permitted again, and the tax increased from one to five ingots per shi.

s0391.literal: An order directed seizure of copper coins; other copper vessels the people were permitted to keep using.
s0391.idiomatic: An order directed seizure of copper coins; other copper vessels the people were permitted to keep using.

s0392.literal: In Fujian, Huanghua She troops with fixed property were made commoners; those without fixed property or with wife and children were enrolled as city-garrison troops.
s0392.idiomatic: In Fujian, Huanghua She troops with fixed property were made commoners; those without fixed property or with wife and children were enrolled as city-garrison troops.

s0393.literal: Wang Weizheng said that garrison troops, relay households, and various people's slaves and maidservants who during famine years had fled into Shaanxi and Sichuan were there immediately registered as army relays.
s0393.idiomatic: Wang Weizheng said that garrison troops, relay households, and various people's slaves and maidservants who during famine years had fled into Shaanxi and Sichuan were there immediately registered as army relays.

s0394.literal: The Emperor said: "If it is truly as you say, they should be gathered and returned; if someone not the owner forcibly tries to take them, would those people not fear the law?"
s0394.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "If it is truly as you say, they should be gathered and returned; if someone not the owner forcibly tries to take them, would those people not fear the law?"

s0395.literal: Ninth month, yihai day: the people were permitted to register and reclaim wasteland in the Two Huai regions, tax-free for three years.
s0395.idiomatic: Ninth month, yihai day: the people were permitted to register and reclaim wasteland in the Two Huai regions, tax-free for three years.

s0396.literal: The Central Secretariat said that revenue and grain of various cities north of the Yangtze under Hang and E branch secretariats' control were too far on circuitous routes; they requested transfer to direct Central Secretariat jurisdiction; this was approved.
s0396.idiomatic: The Central Secretariat said that revenue and grain of various cities north of the Yangtze under Hang and E branch secretariats' control were too far on circuitous routes; they requested transfer to direct Central Secretariat jurisdiction, and this was approved.

s0397.literal: The cities of Yongchang and Tengchong between Burma and Jinchi were battered down and could not repel enemies; an order directed their repair.
s0397.idiomatic: The cities of Yongchang and Tengchong between Burma and Jinchi were battered down and could not repel enemies; an order directed their repair.

s0398.literal: An order said: "From now on tribute shall be only what each region produces; what is not produced locally must not be submitted.
s0398.idiomatic: An order said, "From now on tribute shall be only what each region produces; what is not produced locally must not be submitted.

s0399.literal: " On bingzi day, Chenla and Champa presented ten musicians and medicinal materials, crocodile skins, and other goods.
s0399.idiomatic: " On bingzi day Chenla and Champa presented 10 musicians and medicinal materials, crocodile skins, and other goods.

s0400.literal: On xinsi day, craftsmen in hiding were rounded up.
s0400.idiomatic: On xinsi day craftsmen in hiding were rounded up.
